description: Senior engineer at a 120-person healthtech startup prototyping an intake assistant, aiming for next quarter.

transcript.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant running a short qualification chat for the Voice AI Readiness Assessment. It takes about three minutes. What are you looking to build or improve with voice AI?
We want to prototype a patient intake assistant, kind of a pilot to see if voice works for our clinics.
A pilot for patient intake, nice. Roughly how many people are at your company?
About 120, got it. When are you hoping to have something live?
Probably in four or five months, sometime next quarter.
Next quarter, understood. What are you using today: building in-house, another provider, or starting from zero?
We hacked together an in-house thing with some APIs but it's rough.
Building in-house so far. And what is your role on the team?
I'm a senior software engineer on the platform team.
